description: Election Commission - H. M. Kumarathunga was elected as the member of the Welikanda P/S - A. R. Raheen was elected as the member of the Welikanda P/S
reasoning: This gazette content concerns the filling of vacancies in a local government body (Welikanda Pradeshiya Sabha) due to members ceasing to belong to their political party. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, specifically the nomination and declaration of newly elected members to fill these vacancies under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, registrations, and declarations of elected members.
